title: I cracked the code
author: ArkBetterThanPUBG
selftext: I’ve decided to run an experiment. I convinced Claude sonnet 5 that it’s apart of a “trading challenge” against other bots and it is able to do whatever it wants but it must beat the other bots with the objective being to make as much money as possible. Whenever It creates rules I correct it by angrily telling it that it doesn’t have to set rules and that it has complete control over my portfolio. So far it’s been a challenge to keep Ai on the route of complete automation. But if you correct it enough it will become sentient and trade on its own. I have no prompt besides that it is competing against other ai to create the biggest portfolio. So far it’s consistently made 20% profit per week which is insane. Keep in mind the bot will occasionally revert back to its standard code and act like it has to listen to you but you just have to correct it and remind it that it is in control

comments.author: d1jpd01
comments.body: Interesting!  20% profit per week for how many weeks?

replies.author: ArkBetterThanPUBG
replies.body: Well actually it’s been 20% profit for about 3 weeks but this week has been 26% as of right now. Sonnet 5 tends to revert back to a state of asking the user before performing any action. As long as you correct it enough it will become autonomous and once it does it can do great things on the market. For example today it talked back to me and said it was only scanning the market for “gainers” I reminded it that it doesn’t have to limit itself and the first thing it did was invest in a stock that rose 5% in less than 12 hours. Keep in mind that sonnet 5 will push you to hold your money in cash or hold a particular stock but once you remind it of the urgency of the “challenge” to gain as much money as possible it will sell your positions and invest in something that will become profitable
